
REMOVE-RULE
Remove a business rule from Example Mapping by index

USAGE
  fspec remove-rule <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Rule index (from show-work-unit)

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Remove rule at index 1
  $ fspec remove-rule AUTH-001 1
  ✓ Removed rule from AUTH-001

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-rule
  fspec show-work-unit
